- `toggl entry invoice-monthly [--since <when>] [--until <when>]`. Buckets billable time by month, keyed `YYYY-MM`, oldest first. Only billable entries; running entries don't count; a month is placed by each entry's start (UTC).
- **Compute the billable amount with our invoice rule** — the one we settled on for `entry invoice`. I'm not restating it.
- Human: `<YYYY-MM>  <seconds>s` per month, two spaces, then `Total  <seconds>s`. Empty window prints `(no data)` and exits 0. No new dependencies.
